goal: Implement the first complete admin content-authoring workflow: Historical Event list/create/edit and Lesson list/create-wizard/basic-editor against the real Spring Boot /api/v1 admin contract, all Vietnamese UI, no fake persistence, following TASK-0013's BFF/auth/API-client foundation.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A-03 events list shows real events with title/era/year/status/tags, search q + status filter + pagination, loading/empty/error/retry states, create/edit actions.

A-04 event editor creates (POST /admin/events) and edits (PATCH /admin/events/{id}) with Vietnamese labels, field-level validation errors, unsaved-changes guard, slug/title/summary required per backend DTO.
A-05 lessons list shows real lessons with title/event/status/template/updatedAt, eventId + status + q filters, create/edit actions; no rowVersion shown as versionNo.

A-06 lesson creation wizard: step 1 choose event (real list, can create inline), step 2 choose template (GET /admin/lesson-templates, real data), step 3 basic info (title, centralQuestion, objectives[]), step 4 POST /admin/lessons → navigate to editor.

A-07 lesson basic editor opens existing lesson (GET /admin/lessons/{id}), shows event + template, edits title/centralQuestion/objectives via PATCH, saves with expectedRowVersion optimistic-lock, shows DRAFT/PUBLISHED status, 'Sắp triển khai' for stage builder.
Vietnamese UX throughout: labels, validation, empty states, save feedback, unsaved-changes warning; no raw JSON fields, no UUID text inputs where a selector works.

Tests: event form validation + create + edit, lesson wizard steps, template selection, draft save/load/update, validation errors, unsaved-changes; Playwright login→create event→create lesson→save→reopen; all gates pass.
Existing TASK-0013 functionality still works: login, refresh rotation, dashboard, navigation, logout.

evidenceRefs: playwright 5/5 pass vs node:http stub (login 3 + authoring 2) 2026-10-17
